speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I was not on the book for today. This one is yours. I will put it in your hand and in no one else's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Give it here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Husband, there was fire here on Tuesday the fifteenth, at the north end beyond the Rother Market. Some twenty houses and barns are gone.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Twenty. Not forty. And the north end.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: None of ours is touched, nor any of us hurt, and the children have each a different tale of it.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: She has put the place. The yard would not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sadler's cousin has lost his malt-barn, and Master Quiney is writing to everyone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not come for this. Come for harvest, if you come.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: That is the whole of it. Five lines, and the hand is steady.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Mine is not. Hobbins. Which of this did you have from my wife, and which from the road.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: The twenty is the bailiff's count. I had it in the town, not in an alehouse.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: The forty was an alehouse at Wendover.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: And half the High Street, and Henley Street. You had those on the way.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Those were the road. The town is the north end, and twenty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the brief.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: The town means to sue for a new brief before winter. That I had from Master Quiney's own mouth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the house is the letter, and the forty is the road.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Read it again for the hand. I will stand where I can see it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have read it. None of ours. That is the sentence I keep.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Four days in the saddle, and I would not give the letter to your brother.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: You said nothing more until you had eaten. This is the rest of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not come for this. Come for harvest, if you come. I have those two from her, and not from you.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Then I have done the thing I came out of my day to do.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Twenty. Not forty. And the north end. I can say it now without the yard in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Her hand is steady. I will keep the leaf, and let the forty go.
